# LionSec Hub — Full Context for AI Assistants

> LionSec Hub (CAC BN 9458297, Nigeria) is a global cybersecurity, quantum-safe security
> and digital resilience organisation. Tagline: "Securing critical systems. Protecting
> digital economies. Preparing for the quantum era."
> HQ: Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria (remote-first). Office: 24 Rue du Sentier,
> 75002 Paris, France — open 24 hours, Monday–Sunday.
> Contact: lionsechub@gmail.com · WhatsApp +234 810 754 9232 ·
> Proposal form: /proposal.html

## What LionSec Hub does
Six business divisions:
1. Cyber Defence & Security Operations — pentesting, SOC, detection engineering, threat hunting, DFIR
2. Quantum-Safe Security & Cryptographic Research — PQC migration, QKD advisory, crypto agility
3. Financial Security & Digital Intelligence — fraud prevention, financial crime intelligence
4. National Security & Critical Infrastructure — government, defence, energy, telecoms resilience
5. Secure Engineering & Emerging Technologies — cloud security, secure SDLC, AI/LLM security
6. Academy, Research & Workforce Development — instructor-led professional programmes

Sectors served: banking & finance, government, defence, critical infrastructure, telecoms,
energy, healthcare, enterprise.

## Delivery markets
Nigeria, Ghana, Egypt, France, UK, Italy, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Australia, USA, Canada.
Lagos is the African operations base; Paris is the European office.

## Academy
Seven specialist schools (A–G): foundations, cyber defence/SOC/threat intel, offensive
security, cloud & secure engineering, AI security, quantum-safe security & cryptography,
GRC/privacy/financial security — plus a Corporate & Institutional Academy.
Model: Skill → Labs → Proof → Career. Live instructor-led, portfolio-first.
Tuition (Nigeria): Foundations ₦350,000 · Technical Fast-Track ₦250,000.
Fixed payment plans — two-part or monthly; specialist programmes 60% before commencement
+ 40% by midpoint.
